mainEntity.name: Do I need generative engine optimization if my practice already has a website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, having an existing website is a great starting point, but generative engine optimization can significantly enhance its performance and reach. Many existing websites may lack the depth of content or specific keyword targeting necessary to rank highly in today's competitive search landscape, especially in large markets like Dallas or San Jose. GEO can analyze your current site, identify content gaps, and then generate optimized pages and articles that actively attract new patients. It ensures your website isn't just present, but highly visible and converting visitors into appointments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Even with an existing website, GEO optimizes content, fills gaps, and targets keywords to improve visibility and attract new patients effectively, especially in competitive markets.
